title: Anahit
author: Ghazaros Aghayan
short_summary: Anahit is a kind and hardworking girl who lives with an unkind stepmother and stepsisters, doing all the hardest chores without complaint. When a wise old woman in the forest notices her goodness, she gives Anahit a quiet gift that no unkindness can take away — and it changes the course of her life forever.
extended_summary:
Anahit grows up doing the household's hardest work while her stepmother and stepsisters mock her plain dress and never thank her for her labor. Yet Anahit stays gentle and honest, sharing her bread with hungry animals and helping travelers who lose their way near her village. One day, deep in the forest while gathering firewood, she meets an old woman who is really testing the hearts of everyone she meets. Anahit treats her with the same kindness she shows everyone else, without knowing who the old woman truly is.

Impressed by her honesty and warmth, the old woman blesses Anahit, and soon good fortune begins to follow the girl wherever she goes. When the ruler of the land searches for a wife whose heart matches her beauty, it is Anahit's kindness — not her stepsisters' jealous scheming — that is finally recognized and rewarded. Anahit becomes a beloved queen who never forgets the villagers she grew up among, while her stepsisters' unkindness is exposed for all to see. The tale closes as a gentle reminder that true goodness, however quietly it is practiced, is eventually seen and rewarded.
